Message:
“Primavera” is a special name,
that only The Luminary of Song
has the right to bear.

That day, I inherited
this name from Mother...

But, I wonder if I am
living up to it properly...

I have heard that those who
bore the name “Primavera”
used their songs
to bring hope to many,

with some even being
able to stop wars.

But, in this age sullied by Curses,
I wonder what it is
I should do as “Primavera”...?

Haah... I am sure Mother
never worried about such things...

The flower of the stage,
more noble, and more beautiful,
than any other...
That is “Primavera.”

I shall become a songstress
worthy of this name,
just like Mother was...
